svg.text: Target-zone depth (each zone); Target-zone placement; Halfway line; Centre mark; Markings; Players per team; Goalkeepers; Goalkeepers counted; Team colours; Game Form.
Flags (what prevents a fully accurate drawing):
- Target-zone position: UNRESOLVED; the zones are drawn where the illustrative placement puts them, at the ends.
- Which team attacks which end, and the teams' names, are not in the record: 'Team A' and 'Team B' are drawing labels only, and which arrow points which way is presentation.
- Bib colours are not named in the record: the two team colours are presentation colours, never green.
- Starting relationships are not drawn: the record holds an ordinary kick-off and our reading of 'own half' (OURS). Question: may each team's own half be drawn on that
reading, labelled OURS?
- The end-line restart's location is not drawn: it depends on where the ball went out; the exclusion is our illustrative choice, and the receiving distance is unresolved.
Not drawn, and why:
- Goals: none in the record (no goal stands at either end)
- A centre circle: not among the markings; the coach judges 9.15 m unaided (a gap reported, not filled)
- Players or positions: no value holds them; the team counts are given in words
- Starting relationships: the coach communication standard asks for them, but the record holds only an ordinary kick-off and our reading of 'own half'; see the question above
- The end-line restart location: it depends on where the ball went out; our illustrative exclusion (never into or across a target zone) and an unresolved receiving distance
- The coach's position: in no value
- Spare balls: equipment, not a marking
- A principal-interaction region: which region holds the principal interactions is not established (OURS)
Key (one line per value the drawing reads or states: the value; Christian's class and the label; how it reached the record):
- Area length (end line to end line, target zones included): 40 m; class 5: An illustrative configuration choice; ILLUSTRATIVE (for this offline test only; to be replaced
before any production use); entered
- Area width: 30 m; class 5: An illustrative configuration choice; ILLUSTRATIVE (for this offline test only; to be replaced before any production use); entered
- Target zones inside the length: yes, both inside the length; class 5: An illustrative configuration choice; ILLUSTRATIVE (for this offline test only; to be replaced before
any production use); entered
- Target-zone depth (each zone): 5 m; class 5: An illustrative configuration choice; ILLUSTRATIVE (for this offline test only; to be replaced before any production use);
entered
- Target-zone placement: one at each end, across the full width; class 5: An illustrative configuration choice; ILLUSTRATIVE (for this offline test only; to be replaced before
any production use); entered
- Target-zone position: no value; class 6: An unsupported or unresolved relationship; UNRESOLVED: no authorized value; needs a knowledge decision; no value entered
(UNRESOLVED)
- Target zones (one green): the scoring target: a controlled arrival in the target zone a team attacks; class 3: Candidate or provisional knowledge; RULING, provisional;
entered

- Centre mark: marked; position computed: the centre of the area; class 5: An illustrative configuration choice; ILLUSTRATIVE (for this offline test only; to be replaced

- Teams: 2; class 2: An explicit scoped ruling; RULING; entered

- Team numbers: equal; class 1: Approved canonical knowledge; APPROVED; entered
